name: SEPE (Servicio Público de Empleo Estatal)
parent: Ministerio de Trabajo y Economía Social (Gobierno de España)
notes: Operated by the Spanish public employment service. Country inferred from the government attribution in the logo text; city not stated. Language list includes Valenciano, mapped to ca. No public API or employer pricing stated on pages read.

review.note: The 'Qué es el SEPE' page states neither founding year nor headquarters. The Empléate portal returned 502 to fetch and to the headless reader (blocked), so ingest_methods could not be checked.
